name: Change My Mind
look: A photo on a college campus. Commentator Steven Crowder, in a blue sweater, sits smiling behind a table with a coffee mug in his hand. A white sign hangs on the front of the table with a blank line above the printed words CHANGE MY MIND.
use: The blank line on the sign holds a bold, usually petty or harmless opinion, presented as a hill the poster is ready to defend against anyone who walks up to argue.
slots: the bold opinion (on the sign, above CHANGE MY MIND)
examples: Breakfast for dinner is the best dinner
The middle seat gets both armrests
